record_scope_reconstruction: Montenegrin non-exempt freight protest at nine named land-gate routes: DebeliBrijeg–Karasovici, IlinoBrdo–Klobuk, Vracenovici–Deleusa, Metaljka, Dracenovac–Spiljani, Rance–Jabuka, Dobrakovo–Gostun, Kula–Kulina, Bozaj–HaniHotit. Actual blockades include domestic pull-offs/approaches; Bar maritime terminal excluded.

source_checks.finding: Full HRT reports nine named land gates and cargo exceptions but contains erroneous neighbour assignments (IlinoBrdo/Vitaljina; Dracenovac/Rance with Bosnia). Names cross-checked against official list, not copied as geography.
Official crossing table independently distinguishes road/goods pairings and separate passenger-only gates; confirms IlinoBrdo–Klobuk(BiH), Dracenovac–Spiljani and Rance–Jabuka(Serbia).

Full linked original report locates Bozaj-route trucks at exitTuzi severalkm away, Dobrakovo-route protest at Konatari2km away, Metaljka-route at DajevicaHan, and Rance; passengers/certain goods excepted.
Full January29 report confirms Montenegro suspension after negotiations; not evidence that later Serbian-side restrictions also ceased.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Nine reported Montenegro land cargo posts: Debeli Brijeg–Karasovići (Croatia); Ilino Brdo–Klobuk, Vraćenovići–Deleuša and Metaljka–Metaljka (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Dračenovac–Špiljani, Ranče–Jabuka and Dobrakovo–Gostun (Serbia); Kula–Kulina (Kosovo); Božaj–Hani Hotit (Albania). Port Bar is outside this land-border record.; geographic evidence applies only to this recorded scope.

date_scope_check.assessment: Canonical chronology retained. Duration, short/same-day status, uncertainty or contested dates are not geographic exclusions. No new endpoint inferred.
